en.description: Full-stack software engineer with more than 4 years building web applications and distributed systems using React, TypeScript, Node.js, .NET, SQL, and cloud technologies. Experience in financial products, microservices, automated testing, messaging, and CI/CD.
en.sumaryDescription: I take products from technical definition through delivery, with a focus on quality, scalability, and user experience.

highlights: Develop and maintain web applications with React, TypeScript, and Vite, focused on performance and user experience.
Manage shared state with the Context API and custom hooks, and implement OAuth 2.0 authentication and authorization.
Write unit and integration tests with Vitest and Testing Library, and keep interfaces consistent with SCSS and ESLint.
Designed microservices with Node.js, TypeScript, Express, PostgreSQL, Prisma, RabbitMQ, and real-time communication via WebSocket/Socket.io.

Built web applications with Next.js and React, including multi-step authentication, search, custom profiles, an admin panel, real-time chat, and media upload, with AWS S3 and OpenAI content moderation.
Containerized services with Docker and automated build, test, and deploy pipelines with GitHub Actions.
Built and improved critical banking flows with .NET, ASP.NET MVC, Angular, SQL Server, Azure Functions, and Azure Service Bus.
Refactored services with DDD, Entity Framework Core, and Dapper, and contributed automated tests and code reviews.
Migrated hot data from SQL Server to MongoDB and deployed services with Docker and Kubernetes.
Developed and maintained APIs in a microservices architecture, focused on isolation and scalability.
Built dynamic interfaces with React and TypeScript, using Redux and the Context API for state management.
Added automated tests with Jest and React Testing Library, documented legacy behavior for migration, and joined code reviews.

pt.description: Engenheiro de software full-stack com mais de 4 anos no desenvolvimento de aplicações web e sistemas distribuídos, com React, TypeScript, Node.js, .NET, SQL e cloud. Experiência em produtos financeiros, microserviços, testes automatizados, mensageria e CI/CD.
pt.sumaryDescription: Atuo da definição técnica até a entrega, com foco em qualidade, escalabilidade e experiência do usuário.

highlights: Desenvolvo e mantenho aplicações web com React, TypeScript e Vite, com foco em desempenho e experiência do usuário.
Gerencio estado compartilhado com Context API e hooks customizados, e implemento autenticação e autorização com OAuth 2.0.
Escrevo testes unitários e de integração com Vitest e Testing Library, e mantenho a interface consistente com SCSS e ESLint.
Modelei microserviços com Node.js, TypeScript, Express, PostgreSQL, Prisma, RabbitMQ e comunicação em tempo real com WebSocket/Socket.io.

Desenvolvi aplicações web com Next.js e React, incluindo autenticação em etapas, busca, perfis personalizados, painel administrativo, chat em tempo real e upload de mídia, com AWS S3 e moderação de conteúdo via OpenAI.
Containerizei os serviços com Docker e automatizei build, testes e deploy com GitHub Actions.
Implementei e evoluí fluxos bancários críticos com .NET, ASP.NET MVC, Angular, SQL Server, Azure Functions e Azure Service Bus.
Refatorei serviços com DDD, Entity Framework Core e Dapper, e contribuí com testes automatizados e revisões de código.
Migrei dados da base quente (SQL Server) para MongoDB e fiz deploy com Docker e Kubernetes.
Desenvolvi e mantive APIs em arquitetura de microserviços, com foco em isolamento e escalabilidade.
Construí interfaces dinâmicas com React e TypeScript, usando Redux e Context API para o estado.
Adicionei testes automatizados com Jest e React Testing Library, documentei o legado para migração e participei de code reviews.
